title: Interconnect GUI test infrastructure and product regressions
summary: Created Playwright infrastructure and evolved realistic GUI regression coverage across product generations.

dates.note: Historical analysis identifies GUI CI expansion in 2022, initial Playwright check-in work in 2025 and further coverage in 2026.

facts.text: Created Playwright infrastructure for newer NoC tooling.

Expanded GUI end-to-end coverage and headless Jenkins execution with Xvfb in 2022, introduced initial Playwright check-in tests and reporting helpers in 2025, and expanded product-aware regressions in 2026.
Migrated CMN group coverage, used live Configuration Engine metadata to drive tests, and added renderer/persistence regressions and feature/build-output assertions.
Expanded Angular coverage across 51 spec files in one focused change.

notes: Direct creation evidence supersedes older interpretations limiting Michael to infrastructure extensions. Shared fixtures and later implementations still have contributions by others.
File counts are change scope, not coverage percentages or independent business accomplishments.
